pages.title: Setup and feed
pages.text: The Wafer Fabricator turns high-purity polysilicon into substrates for circuit design. Install it in a sealed cleanroom and supply power.$(br2)The five tiers are SSI, MSI, LSI, VLSI, and ULSI. Higher-tier recipes consume a wafer of the previous tier. Check JEI before preparing inputs.

pages.title: Manufacturing
pages.text: Load the 3×3 input area. Shaped processes require specific positions; shapeless processes allow any arrangement. Extract both results and byproducts.$(br2)Changing inputs resets progress. Inputs lock while a completed batch awaits output space. Poor cleanliness can contaminate the result.

pages.title: Upgrading tiers
pages.text: Prepare a blank wafer of the previous tier for an upgrade recipe. The recipe consumes it and creates a new blank wafer; it does not transfer a saved circuit.$(br2)Keep completed designs separately and reuse them by embedding them in higher-tier wafers at the $(l:siliconic:wafer_assembler)assembler$(/l). Every tier uses a 9×9 grid.
